page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by the x86_64 architecture. The server features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It delivers 104 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, meaning hyperthreading is disabled to ensure predictable, single-threaded core performance. The system is equipped with 192 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.85 GB per core.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a design tradeoff, positioning this server strictly for CPU-bound workloads that rely on network-attached storage.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.c6t.26xlarge offers high compute density with dedicated physical cores, making it suitable for workloads where resource contention must be avoided. The low memory-to-CPU ratio makes it a cost-effective choice for compute-heavy tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive CPU-bound simulations, and large-scale web serving.
